desc: Implement the DP in `Solution.maxProduct` using bitsets for alternating sums, tracking product up to `limit`, and separate structures for non-empty subsequences.
Handle edge cases: k outside [-SHIFT, SHIFT], limit=0, and exclude empty subsequence results.
Test the implementation on the three provided examples and additional random small cases against brute force.
Optimize the inner loop (e.g., iterate only over active products) if needed after testing.
Write clean, well-commented code and ensure correct method signature.
